city.post_town.note: No Brazilian equivalent of a UK post town; literal rendering

city.suburb.note: Brazilian usage has no 'subúrbio' concept for addresses; 'Bairro' is what forms show

city.townland.note: Irish land division with no Portuguese equivalent; kept as the Irish/English term as Portuguese references do

province.prefecture.note: Japanese prefectures are called both 'prefeitura' and 'província' in Brazilian Portuguese
